title: Getting to the office
text:
Staff parking permits cover the underground garage below the Mill Street building. The fee is 52 euros a month. It is available from 6:00 until 15:00. Requests go to phone extension 2584.

Bicycle lockers stand in the covered yard behind the north entrance of the campus. Ask at least 10 working days in advance. Each person may use it 7 times a month. Cancel at least 24 hours before, or the slot is charged.

The shuttle bus runs every morning between the central station and the main gate. It is available from 11:00 until 20:00. Requests go to phone extension 2756. The fee is 42 euros a month.

Electric car chargers are fitted along the back wall on the second garage level. Each person may use it 5 times a month. Cancel at least 9 hours before, or the slot is charged. Ask at least 9 working days in advance.

Public transport passes for regular commuters are ordered through the travel desk. Requests go to phone extension 2419. The fee is 12 euros a month. It is available from 7:00 until 16:00.

title: Rooms and spaces
text:
The boardroom on the top floor has a video wall and a long table for twenty. Cancel at least 22 hours before, or the slot is charged. Ask at least 10 working days in advance. Each person may use it 9 times a month.

Quiet booths line the corridor next to the library and are meant for focused calls. The fee is 53 euros a month. It is available from 6:00 until 15:00. Requests go to phone extension 2571.

The rooftop terrace with its plants and benches can host team events in summer. Ask at least 11 working days in advance. Each person may use it 5 times a month. Cancel at least 11 hours before, or the slot is charged.

The training kitchen in the basement is where the cooking workshops take place. It is available from 7:00 until 16:00. Requests go to phone extension 2546. The fee is 17 euros a month.

The prayer and rest room sits beside the lifts on the first floor of the east wing. Each person may use it 3 times a month. Cancel at least 4 hours before, or the slot is charged. Ask at least 3 working days in advance.

title: Equipment on loan
text:
Spare laptops are lent out by the service desk while your own one is being repaired. Requests go to phone extension 2586. The fee is 92 euros a month. It is available from 6:00 until 15:00.

Portable projectors come in a grey travel case together with every cable you need. Cancel at least 24 hours before, or the slot is charged. Ask at least 13 working days in advance. Each person may use it 3 times a month.

Standing desk converters sit on top of an ordinary desk and lift the screen up. The fee is 60 euros a month. It is available from 8:00 until 17:00. Requests go to phone extension 2343.

Noise-cancelling headsets are handed out to colleagues who sit in open-plan areas. Ask at least 4 working days in advance. Each person may use it 10 times a month. Cancel at least 28 hours before, or the slot is charged.

Camera kits for recording training videos include a tripod, a microphone and lights. It is available from 7:00 until 16:00. Requests go to phone extension 2327. The fee is 19 euros a month.

title: Health and wellbeing
text:
The company gym on the ground floor has rowing machines, bikes and free weights. Each person may use it 7 times a month. Cancel at least 17 hours before, or the slot is charged. Ask at least 12 working days in advance.

Massage sessions are given by a visiting therapist in the treatment room on floor two. Requests go to phone extension 2545. The fee is 31 euros a month. It is available from 7:00 until 16:00.

The yoga class meets in the studio above the canteen with mats and blocks provided. Cancel at least 20 hours before, or the slot is charged. Ask at least 8 working days in advance. Each person may use it 8 times a month.

Eye tests for screen work are carried out by an optician who visits the office. The fee is 64 euros a month. It is available from 11:00 until 20:00. Requests go to phone extension 2707.

Counselling sessions are private conversations with an outside, qualified counsellor. Ask at least 3 working days in advance. Each person may use it 11 times a month. Cancel at least 21 hours before, or the slot is charged.

title: Food and drink
text:
Lunch vouchers can be spent in the staff canteen and at the coffee bar downstairs. It is available from 6:00 until 15:00. Requests go to phone extension 2482. The fee is 21 euros a month.

Fruit boxes with apples, pears and bananas are delivered to every team kitchen. Each person may use it 7 times a month. Cancel at least 14 hours before, or the slot is charged. Ask at least 3 working days in advance.

Catering for meetings is prepared by the canteen kitchen and brought up on trays. Requests go to phone extension 2749. The fee is 63 euros a month. It is available from 10:00 until 19:00.

The barista bar on the atrium level serves espresso, tea and fresh juices to staff. Cancel at least 11 hours before, or the slot is charged. Ask at least 2 working days in advance. Each person may use it 6 times a month.

Sparkling water coolers with chilled and fizzy water stand on every single floor. The fee is 60 euros a month. It is available from 11:00 until 20:00. Requests go to phone extension 2405.

title: Family and care
text:
The childcare centre next door looks after children aged one to four during work. Ask at least 11 working days in advance. Each person may use it 4 times a month. Cancel at least 22 hours before, or the slot is charged.

Holiday camps keep school children busy with sport and crafts in the summer break. It is available from 11:00 until 20:00. Requests go to phone extension 2250. The fee is 17 euros a month.

The parent room has a fridge, a sink and a comfortable chair for nursing mothers. Each person may use it 11 times a month. Cancel at least 32 hours before, or the slot is charged. Ask at least 2 working days in advance.

Backup carers can step in at short notice when your usual childminder is ill. Requests go to phone extension 2383. The fee is 43 euros a month. It is available from 7:00 until 16:00.

The homework club runs in the library after school for the children of colleagues. Cancel at least 8 hours before, or the slot is charged. Ask at least 10 working days in advance. Each person may use it 8 times a month.

title: Learning and growth
text:
Language courses in Dutch, German and Spanish are taught in groups of six learners. The fee is 65 euros a month. It is available from 7:00 until 16:00. Requests go to phone extension 2194.

The leadership programme trains new team leads through workshops and peer coaching. Ask at least 5 working days in advance. Each person may use it 6 times a month. Cancel at least 18 hours before, or the slot is charged.

Online learning licences open a library of thousands of short video courses to you. It is available from 9:00 until 18:00. Requests go to phone extension 2475. The fee is 49 euros a month.

Mentoring pairs a junior colleague with an experienced one from a different team. Each person may use it 4 times a month. Cancel at least 31 hours before, or the slot is charged. Ask at least 4 working days in advance.

Conference tickets are paid from the learning budget whenever you present a talk. Requests go to phone extension 2728. The fee is 91 euros a month. It is available from 11:00 until 20:00.

title: Moving and settling in
text:
Relocation support helps colleagues moving from abroad to find a home and a school. Cancel at least 4 hours before, or the slot is charged. Ask at least 13 working days in advance. Each person may use it 7 times a month.

Temporary apartments close to the office host new colleagues in their first weeks. The fee is 48 euros a month. It is available from 6:00 until 15:00. Requests go to phone extension 2202.

The tax adviser helps newcomers with their first tax return in the new country. Ask at least 6 working days in advance. Each person may use it 11 times a month. Cancel at least 24 hours before, or the slot is charged.

Storage units in the basement keep furniture and boxes safe while you are moving. It is available from 9:00 until 18:00. Requests go to phone extension 2317. The fee is 43 euros a month.

Moving vans can be borrowed from the facilities team for moving house at weekends. Each person may use it 6 times a month. Cancel at least 30 hours before, or the slot is charged. Ask at least 12 working days in advance.
